(c) Since it’s your first time in the city, I’d check out a mix of its major landmarks and smaller hidden gems—you might stumble upon a spot that perfectly captures its local character. (d) Since it’s your first time in the city, I’d check out a mix of its signature art museums and smaller independent galleries—you might stumble upon an exhibition that blends history and modern expression.
